card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The decimal point (period) between digits in a number, right after a leading digit and before the next digit. Seen in section cross-references like (5.2), percentages and dose volumes.

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: Period inside a bracketed section number such as Warnings and Precautions (5.2).

modes.label: Percentages and measures
modes.description: Period inside a decimal percentage or table value.

card.writes: It suppresses the digits that would come next, so the model is pushed away from digits right after the point.
card.plain: It marks the decimal point inside a number, such as 5.2 or 3.5 mL.
